key_findings.finding: Of 342 episodes, 38.6% were selective scaffolding, 29.2% iterative co-composition, 21.3% surface repair and 10.8% delegated composition, where whole AI paragraphs were copied with little revision.

dimensions.appropriate_ai_use: Distinguishes high-agency scaffolding from delegated composition.
dimensions.process_visibility: Screen recordings and prompt logs revealed authorship decisions invisible in final texts.

author_recommendations: Frame responsible use around purpose, verification, transformation, disclosure and responsibility (not tested).
limitations: Single-program setting, and screen recording may have altered composing behaviour.

quality.note: Rich process data; limitations stated in Sec 5.2.

author_recommendations: Design assessments that reward understanding and require student judgement, guided by authentic assessment and constructive alignment (not tested beyond this case).
